opening_filter: Twenty named opening families, two seeded quiet continuations each, sorted legal move choices. No evaluator queried or evaluation/outcome filter. Frozen before games; nested prefixes; reversed colors.

summary.uncertainty_method: Hoeffding bounded pair-score 95% interval; nominal independent opening pairs
summary.limitations: Fast time control; own-evaluator opening filter; capped pairs excluded; no universal Elo claim. Null rating endpoints mean unbounded tails.
